flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/hook/useStagePermissions (EDITABLE/NON_EDITABLE stage lists for general notice editing, alert mounted but its triggers are commented out in mode/edit/EditView and mode/update/UpdateForm). No warrant-outcome-specific validation in the six repos
note: Same as OCMS27.28 but for updating the warrant outcome (executed, cancelled, issued, DNATA). There is no specific validation because recording the outcome itself does not exist (see OCMS27.29). Only the general notice-edit stage rule in useStagePermissions exists; its result is computed but restricts nothing, and the State Court/DNATA alert never appears because its triggers are commented out. Each step fit matches OCMS27.28 (same facts). The story status is blank in the data; the requirement is not given. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. Only the general notice-edit stage list exists and it restricts nothing; validation specific to warrant outcome update does not exist

steps.step: Outcome update conditions, such as notice stage, are defined
steps.detail: There is no list of conditions specific to updating outcome warrant. The only stage list is EDITABLE/NON_EDITABLE for general notice editing (useStagePermissions.tsx:27-55); no configuration or parameter for warrant conditions.

steps.step: OCMS checks the notice stage against the conditions
steps.detail: useStagePermissions reads the notice last_processing_stage and checks whether it is in the EDITABLE list (NPA, ENA, RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3, CFC, CPC) or NON_EDITABLE list (CSD, CSR, COS, COM, COT, CTM, CTT, CWM, CTW, COW, CWW). This is a general notice-edit rule, not a warrant update condition. The editable result is only passed as a parameter to useNoticeSubmit (ActionNotice.tsx:78) and there it only appears in a dependency array (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:261), with no visible effect. The stage is compared, but nothing is restricted.

steps.step: Officer is prompted when the notice is not valid
steps.detail: The modal alert 'Notice has been submitted to State Court. Please apply DNATA and perform an EMCONs to edit the notice' exists in useStagePermissions.tsx:86, but every caller that would show it (EditView.tsx:228-237 and UpdateForm.tsx:155-163) is commented out, so the prompt never appears. Its text is also about editing a notice, not updating a warrant.

steps.step: Outcome update is blocked or allowed by the result
steps.detail: There is no server-side validation for updating outcome warrant: no warrant update endpoint exists in the six repos (grep returns nothing), so nothing can be rejected or allowed.
